lastResponse.text: You’re doing the right thing. Closest option to downtown is Community Meals and Pantry at 909 Southwest eleventh Avenue. Call first: 503… 228… 7465. Say: “I’m near the bus mall, no food, and need help right now.” They have meals, pantry food, clothing, and hygiene supplies. When you get there, ask staff for a safe Place to sit and a phone outlet to charge. If you feel in immediate danger, call nine one one now.
originalTexts: You’re doing the right thing. Closest option to downtown is **Community Meals and Pantry** at **909 Southwest 11th Avenue**. Call first: **503… 228… 7465**. When you get there, ask staff for a safe place to sit and a phone outlet to charge. If you feel in immediate danger, call **911** now.
